# 做好SEO基本功也能持续增加AI提及

- 作者：Flavio Amiel（@fba）
- 原帖发布时间：2025-12-04 00:07（北京时间）
- 原帖：https://x.com/fba/status/1996250046564597945
- 收藏日期：2026-10-29

## 中文全文

这个老项目一直在变好、变好、再变好。

我做的是：扎实、传统、标准的 SEO。

我没做的是：‘GEO’。

尽管没有做‘GEO’，或者你们愿意给它起的其他名字，它的 AI 提及、流量、外链等等，依然在持续增长。

我的 𝕏 账号永远不会靠讨论那些可能只管用几周、几个月的破玩意儿来制造刺激。

我主要关注今天管用、明天也管用的东西。

为此，我必须测试并应用最佳实践。

确保那些真正有价值的环节都被照顾好。

今天要让它奏效，你不需要太多东西，只需要把正确的事做对。

就这么简单。

---

## 英文原文

This old project keeps getting better and better and better.

What I do:  good, old, standard SEO.

What I don't do: "GEO".

And regardless of not "GEO" (or whatever you guys want to name it), it's constantly increasing AI mentions, traffic, and backlinks. etc.

My 𝕏 account will never be exciting and commenting about shit that might work for a couple of weeks or months.

I'm mostly focused on things that work today and tomorrow. 

For that I have to test and apply the best practices.

Ensure that the good bits are being taken care of.

You don't need much to make it work today. Just doing the right things right.

It's that simple.
